The National strategy for agriculture and rural

development for 2007-2013 sets out six main

priorities for the agriculture sector under the

overarching goal of EU accession: (i) increasing

the sector competitiveness; (ii) improving quality

and food safety; (iii) better resource management;

(iv) improving the living conditions in the rural
